rooms.name: Hub - The Restaurant and Farm
rooms.description: The heart of the archipelago. Your restaurant awaits fresh ingredients from the neighboring islands. Bridges lead west to Komolexos, north to Jeetomal, and east to Fugoumitak Sanctuary.

rooms.name: Komolexos
rooms.description: The southwestern island of the archipelago. Its sunny hills offer a breathtaking view of the ocean. A bridge leads to the Hub to the east and a passage connects to Vinterfint to the north.

rooms.name: Jeetomal
rooms.description: The large central mountainous island where quality cattle are raised, guarded by the Queen Of Cows. Four bridges lead south to the Hub, west to Vinterfint, north to Smycka, and east to Kuggis.

rooms.name: Smycka
rooms.description: A rugged island in the north of the archipelago swept by sea breezes. Bridges connect west to Fejka, south to Jeetomal, and east to Kuggis.

rooms.name: Vinterfint
rooms.description: A rocky, mysterious island to the west of the archipelago. It connects south to Komolexos, east to Jeetomal, and north to Fejka.

rooms.name: Fejka
rooms.description: The northwestern island of the archipelago where fresh eggs are gathered. Bridges lead south to Vinterfint and east to Smycka.

rooms.name: Kuggis
rooms.description: A vast wooded island in the east teeming with rare wild mushrooms, but guarded by the Wild Guardian. Bridges lead west to Jeetomal and north to Smycka.

rooms.name: Fugoumitak Sanctuary
rooms.description: The final island to the east of the Hub. Amidst ancient stone slabs rests the ancient chest, guarded by the Supreme Critic.

items.name: Flour
items.description: Bag of flour available at the Hub. Essential base for savory pastry and the Beef Wellington.

items.name: Beef
items.description: Prime cut of beef from Jeetomal, guarded by the Queen of Cows. Heart of the Beef Wellington.

items.name: Egg
items.description: Fresh egg from Fejka. Essential for glazing and assembling the Beef Wellington.

items.name: Mushroom
items.description: Wild mushroom from Kuggis, guarded by the Wild Guardian. Essential for the Wellington duxelles.

items.name: Beef Wellington
items.description: The culinary masterpiece prepared by Chef Gusto combining Flour, Beef, Egg, and Mushroom. Consuming it (USE Beef Wellington) fully restores your vitality (+100 HP) to defeat the Supreme Critic!

items.name: Chest
items.description: An ancient treasure chest resting on the altar of Fugoumitak. Using it (USE Chest) grants its content: the legendary Chef's Hat!

items.name: Chef Hat
items.description: The prestigious Chef's Hat from the Sanctuary Chest. Symbol of absolute culinary mastery!

npcs.name: Apprentice Waiter
npcs.description: The restaurant waiter at the Hub.
dialogue: Welcome to the Hub! We have Flour right here in the restaurant.
Talk to Chef Gusto to begin your culinary journey across the archipelago.
Do not challenge the Supreme Critic on Fugoumitak without consuming a Beef Wellington first!

npcs.name: Chef Gusto
npcs.description: The head chef of the restaurant who provides progression quests.
dialogue: Welcome! We need fresh ingredients from across the archipelago to prepare our signature dishes.
North in Jeetomal lies prime beef, northwest in Fejka fresh eggs, and east in Kuggis wild mushrooms.
Once you bring me all the ingredients, we will craft the legendary Beef Wellington!
Eating the Beef Wellington will give you the strength to defeat the Supreme Critic on Fugoumitak and open the ancient chest!

npcs.name: Butcher
npcs.description: A depressed butcher on Jeetomal island who lost his job when The Queen Of Cows seized control of the pastures.
dialogue: Sigh... Look at my rusty cleaver. Ever since The Queen Of Cows took power on Jeetomal, my butcher shop has been completely empty.
Sheoverthrew my pastures, rallied the cattle, and forbade anyone from touching the prime beef.
I just want my job back... Please, ask me for a QUEST and defeat The Queen Of Cows so I can work again!

npcs.name: The Queen Of Cows
npcs.description: The Queen of the cows on Jeetomal guarding the legendary beef.
dialogue: If you want the legendary beef of Jeetomal, you will need to pass through me!

npcs.name: Wild Guardian
npcs.description: A fierce creature guarding the mushrooms on Kuggis.
dialogue: Grrr... The mushrooms of Kuggis are mine!

npcs.name: Supreme Critic
npcs.description: The final boss guarding the chest on Fugoumitak.
dialogue: You dare enter Fugoumitak? Only one empowered by the legendary Beef Wellington can hope to defeat me!
Prove to me that you are worthy of culinary greatness!

quests.description: Jeetomal Pastures: Go defeat The Queen Of Cows guarding the beef.
Jeetomal Beef: Go north to Jeetomal and bring Beef to Chef Gusto.
Fejka Eggs: Journey northwest to Fejka and bring Egg to Chef Gusto.
Secure Kuggis: Go east to Kuggis and defeat the Wild Guardian.
Kuggis Mushrooms: Gather from the woods and bring Mushroom to Chef Gusto.
Bake Wellington: Combine all gathered ingredients and bring Flour to Chef Gusto to prepare the Beef Wellington.
Fugoumitak Boss: Consume your Beef Wellington and defeat the Supreme Critic.

reward.name: Master of Fugoumitak: Access to the Chest
